title: Chloe: card left at a restaurant

steps.text: Hello, thanks for calling {{bank_name}}. You're speaking with the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded. Could I start with your full name, please?
Hey, it's Chloe Anderson. I can't find my card. I think I left it at a restaurant last night. Can you stop it for now?

steps.intent: Card possibly left at a restaurant
steps.summary: Caller thinks she left her debit card at a restaurant and wants it stopped for now.

steps.text: No stress, we'll sort it. Just two quick details first. What's your date of birth?
Thanks {{submit_identity_answers.first_name|Chloe}}, you're confirmed. Thank you for that. I'll need to place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.
Thanks for holding. I can see your debit card. Since it may turn up, I'll put a temporary lock on it now.
All done, your card's locked, so nobody can use it. If it turns up, just call us and we can unlock it, and if it doesn't, we can block it and send you a new one.
The last purchase I can see was at {{lock_card.last_transaction.merchant|a shop near you}}. Does that sound right?

steps.intent: Card possibly left at a restaurant
steps.summary: Card ending 4148 temporarily locked. Chloe recognised the last transaction.

steps.text: Lovely. I've texted you a confirmation, and your reference is {{lock_card.case_number|in that message}}. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's it. Thanks so much!
